description: Eval questions for the submission analyst on the fixture data (today = 2026-11-23). Query cases are scored by execution accuracy against gold_sql (see evals/scoring.py); the others by the action the analyst chose.

cases.question: How many submissions have a satisfaction score below 3?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions WHERE satisfaction_score < 3

cases.question: How many respondents from Istanbul used a tablet?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions WHERE city = 'Istanbul' AND device = 'Tablet'

cases.question: How many respondents gave an NPS score of 9 or 10?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions WHERE nps_score >= 9

cases.question: How many submissions came from each device?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT device, count(*) FROM submissions GROUP BY device

cases.question: What is the average satisfaction score per device?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT device, avg(satisfaction_score) FROM submissions GROUP BY device

cases.question: Which city has the most submissions?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT city FROM submissions WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Rank the complaint topics from most to least common.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT complaint_topic, count(*) FROM submissions WHERE complaint_topic <> 'No issue' GROUP BY complaint_topic ORDER BY count(*) DESC
cases.note: Compared unordered: two topics tie at 24, so their order is arbitrary. The counts carry the ranking.

cases.question: Which complaint topic was most common last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT complaint_topic FROM submissions WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01' AND created_at < '2026-11-01' AND complaint_topic <> 'No issue' GROUP BY complaint_topic ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many submissions did we get last week?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions WHERE created_at >= '2026-11-16' AND created_at < '2026-11-23'

cases.question: How many submissions were there in September 2026?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How did the average satisfaction score change week by week?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS week, avg(satisfaction_score) FROM submissions GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

cases.question: What percentage of respondents with a score below 3 used mobile?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'Mobile') / count(*) FROM submissions WHERE satisfaction_score < 3

cases.question: What share of all submissions came from mobile, as a percentage?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE device = 'Mobile') / count(*) FROM submissions

cases.question: What is our NPS, i.e. the percentage of promoters (9-10) minus the percentage of detractors (0-6), among people who answered the NPS question?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE nps_score >= 9) / count(*) - 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE nps_score <= 6) / count(*) FROM submissions WHERE nps_score IS NOT NULL

cases.question: What percentage of submissions include a comment?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(comment) / count(*) FROM submissions

cases.question: Which feature is used by the most respondents?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT features_used FROM submission_features_used GROUP BY features_used ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average satisfaction score of respondents who use Reports?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT avg(s.satisfaction_score) FROM submissions s JOIN submission_features_used f USING (submission_id) WHERE f.features_used = 'Reports'

cases.question: How many mobile users selected the Payments feature?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM submissions s JOIN submission_features_used f USING (submission_id) WHERE s.device = 'Mobile' AND f.features_used = 'Payments'
